text: Not as pictured. According to the company, they have changed the handles on this model and it will not come with beige plastic handles as pictured rather than the wooden ones. product_metadata.title: Cubiker Dresser for Bedroom with 4 Drawers, Big Fabric Storage Tall Tower Dresser for Hallyway Closets, Sturdy Steel Frame, Wood Top, Black Grey
features: Modern design: looks great in any space – living rooms, bedrooms, hallways, entryways, closets, nurseries, etc. This dresser only takes up small space while still provide plenty of storage space.
Material: Fabric Non-woven fabric drawer can be wiped directly with a wet cloth; Solid MDF board with Waterproof design; Easy pull drawers with wooden handles for smooth opening and closing.

Sturdy durable: Anti-tipping system can protect you from any hurt. High-quality strong steel frame; Adjustable feet with plastic cover protect your floor. X-steel frame ensure your drawer dresser more stable.
Bigger drawers: Level-up dresser(L: 19.7" x D: 11.8 " x H: 46.9 ") which is bigger than any other same dressers, could provide larger storage space and meet your daily use.
Easy assemble: Clear manual, all screws, and tools are offered in the package. You can set up the whole drawer dresser within 15-30 minutes by following the manual step by step.
